Kay Kraft's Ekushey collection
2018-02-20T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/kay-krafts-ekushey-collection-1536994

Throughout the month of February, Kay Kraft is offering their latest collection reflecting the solemn tone of the month. The collection features motifs with Bangla alphabets and words. For colours -- black, red, grey and white have been given precedence.

The collection has panjabis, saris, shirts etc. as well as clothes for children.

The entire collection can be found at all Kay Kraft outlets as well on their website.

For more information, please visit www.kaykraft.com
